notes.title: Version Update 1.0.7
notes.notes: Good news! We're currently expecting a lot of new players, so we've streamlined the experience of getting to know Swarm Universe! Other improvements include more freedom when it comes to skipping scenes and tutorials, as well as some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Summer Sale & Version Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/11a01a9817675dcf00491b2f398f2647d7947d6f.png
Summer Sale!
No reason to wait any longer - it's summer sale and Swarm Universe is 50% off once more!

What's new?
We've extended the already massive scope of our modding capabilities again, we've fixed some minor bugs and we've added a helpful popup for players still unaware of all the free bonus-content we are publishing through the Steam Workshop!

Changes in Version 1.0.5 

General

Added popup that invites players to subscribe to a few selected Workshop items
Fixed Bot-7's swarm remaining active when leaving the scene through skipping
Decreased volume of ping sound


Modding

Added script functions

game.playSound(): Currently only able to play the "E-Mail" sound used in "Showdown"
bot.lookAtBox(): Makes the bot look at what he is saying
bot.setMoveParticles(): Enables/disables the bot's particle effect while moving
bot.setSize(): Changes the size of a bot
game.getInputName(): Returns a string describing the configured input for a given action
game.logoEnding(): Initiates the outro used in "Showdown"
game.whiteFlash(): A dip-to-white that can be used to hide camera jumps
player.recallDrones(): Transforms all drones into "ghosts" and immediately recalls them

Fixed bot.setBoxWidth()
Fixed script-activated enemy-actions not triggering properly when activated continuously
Updated script documentation

notes.title: Massive Content Update & Sale!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/b803a029991e6971b6ecd787cd4b0283f44626e5.jpg

Celebration Time!
As Swarm Universe is available for two months now, we felt it's time to celebrate this event with a massive content-update and a very special price! 8 new official maps have just been released in the Workshop: 4 single-player and 4 multiplayer maps. Get 'em now!.

With this update, a total of 12 official additional single- and multiplayer maps have been added to the Workshop since the game's launch, plus lots of user-generated content - thank you! 

The universe is expanding!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/bbf7ed17458668db18ed7453ab26e61eca22c77b.jpg

4 new single-player maps!
Deal with your worst nightmares in "Paranoia", defend the all powerful "Orb" that grants total power once it's charged, explore the monstrous "Plant" and discover your path to victory or check out our little modding-power demonstration called "Serpent" and eat some apples. Something for everyone!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937442913
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937439709
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937448324
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=937461232

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/de56c8e52173f2fd4f6d06590983a6b1e585eec9.jpg

4 new multiplayer maps!
A panic room that makes you panic even more, a cave with changing paths that could prove fatal, a map designed for the power of three and another addition to one of our many game-modes: Capture the Flag!

notes.title: Version Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/8c93be95799a73ba18970486e75afeecab196fdd.jpg

What's new?
We've opened more of our ever-growing, official Workshop content, fixed all currently confirmed bugs, made our scroll-bars draggable and added even more functionality to the modding section. But what will it be used for? Is something big coming? Who knows!

Changes in Version 1.0.4 

General

Made scroll-bars draggable
Fixed visual glitch in the spawn animation of enemies spawned by other enemies
Fixed shots fired by enemies in contact with walls sometimes glitching through walls


Modding

Added filter/search function for presets
Added custom colors for script positions
Added script functions

game.createEffect(): Creates an effect with custom settings, currently only explosions
game.spawnBonus(): Creates a bonus like "Speed Boost" or "Level Up"
game.allowGlobes(): Allows/disallows enemies to drop globes
se.isScriptRunning(): Checks if a script with the specified name is currently running

Extended script function game.killAllEnemies() to allow exceptions
Added safety limit for globes and bonuses
Enhanced preset names in level templates
Updated script documentation
Made more official Workshop items extractable

Bad Neighborhood
Claustrophobia
Close Combat
Compression
Find the Match
Least Resistance
Line of Sight
Monodrone
Movement 101

notes.title: Content Update: Big Bang
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/ba9f72de59294737c75412c173ff14a17bc86e7c.jpg

Big Bang - for Players and Modders!
A new stand-alone arena, that's also fully editable! Jump in right away and try to score high, or use it as an arena modding template.

Attention Players!
Matter and Anti-Matter particles are trying to stop you from achieving the highscore that you've always wanted. Don't let them meet!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/0e3263decb1c88285664b6019db00d1377ef0ee5.png

Attention Modders!
While the regular Swarm Universe arenas are controlled by complex scripts, this one is editable without any scripting knowledge! Just subscribe, import the level into your modding section and find lots of switches and instructions everywhere! This level doubles as an ARENA TEMPLATE.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/40dd65ce0f11a79ba38008648ff96d8e8de6a153.png

notes.title: Content Update: Mothership
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/7e017b05a6ac1882a6fb602fd7a7e6ae806d59e7.jpg

Extractable single-player map!
There you are, innocently exploring the asteroids of Sector 7-B... when suddenly a giant alien mothership appears! It seems determined to ruin your day.

Bossfights!
This Survival Arena brings you a vile boss in the form of an alien mothership in various stages. Are you a match for all its lasers, homing missiles, bombs and attack fighters?

The map is fully extractable with the Swarm Universe Level-Editor, so you may build something completely different on that basis. Have fun!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=904404351

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Official Release
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27989211/fbf2ad41181092c6c97ed5866c20e6fc71f5a713.jpg

Swarm Universe - out now!
Wow, this feels almost surreal. We've done our best to make Swarm Universe as good as we can and hope you enjoy it! Since the pre-launch version we've worked on some improvements:

Changes in Version 1.0.1

General

    Game now continues to run when tabbed out of real fullscreen modes 
    Removed enemies' proximity shield 


Multiplayer

    Added "Play Again" button
    Improved lobby search
    Last host settings will be remembered now 
    Added player names, shown below other players 



Additional Workshop Content

Single-Player Arena  No Escape
Single-Player Arena  Twister


We'll keep improving and adding more workshop content. Cheers!
